scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/web' build && bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/lit' build && bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/vue' build
scripts.build:apps: bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-lit-demo build && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-vue-demo build
scripts.test: bun run test:packages && bun run test:apps
scripts.test:packages: bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/web' test && bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/lit' test && bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/vue' test
scripts.test:apps: bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-lit-demo test && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-vue-demo test
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/*' test:browser && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-lit-demo test && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-vue-demo test
scripts.test:browser:headed: PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS=false bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/*' test:browser && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-lit-demo test:headed && bun run --filter floating-ui-plus-vue-demo test:headed
scripts.dev: bun run --filter '@floating-ui-plus/*' build && bun run --workspaces --parallel dev
